title: Test Covers Dollar Sign in Code Block Not Typeset
description: The frontend module shall have a test asserting that a dollar sign inside a fenced code block is not typeset.
rationale: The code-region exclusion regex has two fence variants: four-or-more hyphens and four-or-more dots. The dot-fence variant was broken in a prior draft due to a regex error. Without an explicit negative-case test for each fence variant, that class of regression goes undetected before reaching students whose course sections contain code examples with dollar-prefixed variables.
